SD65-006.name: The Four Towers of Limbo
SD65-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Evil God" family Ultimate attacks, your counter +1. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) either draw a card, or put a core from the Void to that Ultimate.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your Life is reduced, you can summon an Ultimate card from your Hand with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters, without paying the cost.

SD65-001.name: The HellflameCount Zan-Zival
SD65-001.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit, or an opposing Nexus.

[LV4][LV5] (Start of Your Attack Step)
Send up to five cores from your Trash to your “Evil God”/"Next Generation" family Ultimates/Nexuses. Then, you can send two cores from your other "Evil God" family Ultimates/Nexuses to the Trash. When you've done so, destroy an opposing originally Cost 3 or less Grandwalker Nexus.

SD65-X01.name: The Hellflame FourDemonLord Bram-Zahfag
SD65-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned)
Destroy every opposing Spirit. Then, (Once per Game: Same Name) by sending one of your Lives to the Void, until your next Start Step, the opponent can't summon Spirit cards. This "can't summon" effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV4][LV5] (Your Attack Step)
While your “Evil God” family Ultimate is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

SD65-005.name: The HellseaCount Ila-Riva
SD65-005.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one counter or more]

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. Then, if this Burst was activated via your "Evil God" family effect, look at the entire opposing Hand, and discard a Magic card among them. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by sending a core from your Field/Reserve to the Trash, set a Burst card from your Hand.

SD65-004.name: The HellwindCount Nouvelle-Vague
SD65-004.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any “The PartnerDemonLord Javad”, by sending two cores from your Reserve to the Trash, summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to this Ultimate, and exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you have six counters or more, you can return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

SD65-X04.name: The Hellsea FourDemonLord Ill-Dezal
SD65-X04.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest cost. Then, destroy two opposing Spirits with a cost equal or inferior to the number of your counters. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV4][LV5] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
While your "DemonLord" is attacking, by sending a core from that Ultimate to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Bursts.

SD65-X03.name: The Hellwind FourDemonLord Van-Tous
SD65-X03.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
By returning a card from your Hand to the decktop, put two cores from the Void to any of your Ultimates, and during this turn, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Besides [Soul Core], by sending a core from your Trash to the Void, reveal a number of cards from your decktop up to the number of counters you have. Among them, you can summon up to three “DemonLord” without paying the cost, or [Contract Advent] them. Banish any remaining cards.

SD65-002.name: The HellsoilCount Grey-Tude
SD65-002.effect:
[Summon Condition: You have one or more counters]

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Turn)
By discarding this Mirage, your counter +1. When you do, send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned)
Your counter +1, and draw a card.

SD65-X02.name: The Hellsoil FourDemonLord Magnazappah
SD65-X02.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more "The PartnerDemonLord Javad", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Evil God" family Ultimates would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Count Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Summoned/Attacks)]
When Count Ultimate Trigger hits, once per turn, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Trash.
[cutb]

SD65-003.name: The Ruler of FourDemonLords Lord-Javad
SD65-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Hell Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Ultimate.

[SuAdcon: You control one or more “The PartnerDemonLord Javad”, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition]

[LV3][LV4] (When Summoned/Advents)
By discarding a card from your Hand, draw two cards. When this effect discards any "Evil God" family card, send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[During OC] [LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, by sending the [Soul Core] from your Trash to this Ultimate, this Ultimate refreshes.

SD65-CX01.name: The PartnerDemonLord Javad
SD65-CX01.effect:
[Summon Condition: Your Life is at two or more]

[Soul State][Contract Pre-Advent]/[Ultimate] [LV3][LV4]
(Can't Stack) When your cores or the opposing cores are sent to the Void/Trash from the Life/Field/Reserve/Trash by your "Evil God" family effects, your counters +2. Also, if that's a "DemonLord" effect, you can draw a card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Ultimate] [LV3][LV4] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can send a core from your Field/Reserve to the Trash. When you've done so, send two cores from an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve.
